title: PROJECT 7 - Privacy-preserving synthetic healthcare data generation
summary: A student research project evaluating whether synthetic healthcare data (diabetes health indicators) can preserve statistical fidelity and research utility while resisting membership inference attacks, comparing no-privacy, moderate-privacy, and strong-privacy generation approaches. It trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer alongside a differentially-private CTGAN variant, and uses SDV's evaluate_quality and run_diagnostic functions to assess synthetic data quality.
